headline: Google Ads groups appointment tracking under one Book Appointment goal
dek: Google rewrote its Partner bookings help page as the Book Appointment conversion goal, which it says covers scheduled appointments, reservations and service bookings, Search Engine Roundtable reported on November 24. Partner bookings, appointment conversion actions and calls from ads now sit together under Book Appointment on the Goals summary page. Google says healthcare campaigns may not use booking links or this goal.
why: A service business can now aim its campaigns at booked appointments, which ties ad spend closer to revenue than form fills or page views do. The report describes an expanded help document, so the goal itself may not be brand new.
doThis: If you run Google Ads for a salon, gym or home service, set up a Book Appointment conversion action, make a test booking to confirm it records, and compare cost per booking after 30 days.
